difficulty_reason: The lemma represents a point of a site as a morphism of sites from the site built out of a sufficiently large powerset, in such a way that the induced morphism of topoi is the given point (statement lines 8338-8360). The proof is short and complete: the equivalence is recalled from the companion remark together with the description of its direct image (proof lines 8363-8367); the functor is checked to define a morphism of sites directly from the definitions (proof lines 8368-8371); and the composite of the pushforwards is computed and identified with the pushforward along the point (proof lines 8372-8378). The non-formal content is the computation of the composite. The claim is H1: three short steps, each written out.
